page_title: GET 1-3 PAL | Getafe v Las Palmas 12/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Omar Alderete (Getafe) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.
90+3' Carles Perez (Getafe) makes a rough challenge and Javier Alberola blows his whistle for a foul.
90+2' Wonderful movement by Getafe. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' It will be a corner kick for Las Palmas.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Fabio Silva trots off the pitch and is replaced by Alex Munoz (Las Palmas).
85' The referee shows the yellow card to Jaime Mata (Las Palmas).
83' Getafe failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
83' A quickly taken corner by Getafe.
82' Coba Gomez da Costa (Getafe) jinks his way past two defenders and from the edge of the box has an effort which goes just wide of the right post.
80' Dinko Horkas displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Borja Mayoral (Getafe) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
78' Diego Martinez prepares a substitution. Oliver McBurnie is replaced by Jaime Mata (Las Palmas).
76' Substitution. Carles Perez (Getafe) has come on for Ramon Terrats.
74' 1 - 3 GOAL! Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over David Soria, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 1:3.

73' The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick. Great solo effort from Javier Munoz (Las Palmas)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort rose just over the bar.
71' Las Palmas are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
69' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) was too forceful with his tackle and Javier Alberola interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
67' Coba Gomez da Costa (Getafe) creates space for himself on the edge of the box and smacks a hard shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's an easy save for Dinko Horkas.
67' It will be a substitution. Coba Gomez da Costa (Getafe) is ready to enter the pitch as Juan Bernat walks off.
66' Jose Bordalas Jimenez decides to make a substitution. Christantus Uche will be replaced by Borja Mayoral (Getafe).
66' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Juan Bernat (Getafe) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The linesman signals a throw-in for Getafe.
64' Las Palmas are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
63' Here comes a substitution. Sandro Ramirez is given a rest as he is replaced by Manuel Fuster (Las Palmas).
61' 1 - 2 Fantastic team goal! Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) was set free in the area by Alberto Moleiro and he made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom left corner. 1:2.
58' Las Palmas are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
57' A substitution has been made. Juanmi is replaced by Allan Nyom (Getafe).
57' Getafe show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
53' 1 - 1 What a magnificent finish! Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) wonderfully times his run onto a cross and thunders the ball from deep inside the box into the left side of the net!
52' Juanmi (Getafe) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
51' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
48' Javier Alberola shows a yellow card to Stefan Bajcetic (Las Palmas) for his blatant foul.
47' Las Palmas fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
46' Diego Martinez makes a half-time substitution. Marvin comes on in place of Viti (Las Palmas).
46' Half-time substitution. Dario Essugo (Las Palmas) will not participate anymore and Alberto Moleiro is coming on.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+4' The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick. What an opportunity! Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes just wide of the left post!
45+3' Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) commits a rough foul. Javier Alberola stops the game and makes a call.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' Looks like Viti (Las Palmas) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
44' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is out of play. Getafe will have a throw-in.
41' Wonderful movement by Las Palmas. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
40' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
39' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
38' Javier Alberola interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Mauro Arambarri (Getafe). Las Palmas win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
36' Getafe can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
33' The referee shows a red card to Diego Rico (Getafe). He can have an early bath!
33' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Diego Rico (Getafe)! Let's see what he decides.
32' Diego Rico (Getafe) is penalised.

31' Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception. Now Las Palmas have a corner.
30' Dario Essugo (Las Palmas) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Javier Alberola saw the whole situation.
29' Luis Milla (Getafe) decides to have a shot at goal from the free kick, but it hits the defensive wall.

27' Christantus Uche (Getafe) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the right side of the goal. Dinko Horkas is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.

23' Las Palmas slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.

19' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Luis Milla flights the free kick into the box, where Omar Alderete (Getafe) peels off his marker and heads it low into the centre of the goal from the edge of the six-yard box. He makes it 1:0.
19' Wait! Referee Javier Alberola immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
19' It seemed like Luis Milla (Getafe) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
17' Juanmi (Getafe) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
17' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) meets a cross inside the box, but David Soria wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.

16' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Getafe are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
12' Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
10' The Las Palmas players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
8' Christantus Uche (Getafe) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Getafe.
7' Getafe are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The ball has crossed the sideline. Getafe are taking a throw-in.
5' Javier Alberola blows his whistle as Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
3' Stefan Bajcetic (Las Palmas) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.
1' Las Palmas seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Las Palmas will have the kick-off.
Javier Alberola will supervise the game today.
